title: Mad Bullz
description:
Mad Bullz is a physics-based destruction game focused on chaotic combat, ragdoll interactions, and over-the-top weapons.Smash, shoot, and impale everything in a fully physics-driven world where every interaction creates unpredictable results.

Destruction gameplayUse powerful melee weapons like Bull-Hammer to destroy objects with realistic physics reactions.

Unique hybrid weaponsFight with creative tools like the Swordbow. Exploit the environment to your advantage - explode barrels, trigger traps, and turn the world itself into a weapon.

Ragdoll chaosImpale enemies with weapons like Scythe and watch dynamic ragdoll physics take over.

First-person combatExperience destruction from a first-person perspective using precision-based ranged attacks.

Environmental killsUse spikes, traps, and level hazards to eliminate enemies in creative and brutal ways.

Key Features• Physics-based destruction system

• Ragdoll combat interactions

• Hybrid melee + ranged weapons

• First-person combat moments

• Environmental kill mechanics

• Sandbox-style chaotic gameplay

For fans ofPhysics sandbox games, ragdoll chaos, destruction simulators, and emergent gameplay systems.

Enjoying the chaos? Add Mad Bullz to your Wishlist or buy Early Access!Have fun! Muuuuuu!
description_short: Physics-based 3D action game with chaotic destruction, ragdoll combat, and environmental interactions.
